title: chore(apps): correct URLs and remove 25 unavailable apps
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Removed 25 catalog entries whose app links still failed after a third scoped check more than eight hours after the first, with no working listed repository; the checks do not establish permanent abandonment. Cleared failed app links for 7 entries with working repositories, removed AINewsForge’s “Not public” placeholder and 2 website addresses incorrectly listed as repositories, corrected 3 website URLs to HTTPS, and updated 1 transferred GitHub repository URL. Previously recovered apps were unchanged. Validation passed across the 857-entry catalog.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden catalog, Polli tends lime green (#ecf874) code-plants beside a retro screen showing tidy app cards, while a small stack of outdated cards rests off to the side; soft pastel gradients and warm lighting give the scene a cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic with retro gaming vibes. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny gardener’s gloves, stays small within the scene, and is strictly pixel art, never realistic.
